title: Sticker gravity
description: Eight graphic club seals tumble into a shallow tray and collide as individual draggable bodies.
useCase: Turn a small set of circular badges into a playful physical arrangement.
interaction: Drag and release a seal, or pause and arrange it with the keyboard.
reducedMotion: The simulation begins paused; badges can still be placed directly with pointer or keyboard controls.
limitations: Eight bounded circular bodies with a fixed-step impulse solver. This is intentionally not general polygon physics.
look: Off-white sheet between header and footer rules, with eight flat circular stickers in orange, cobalt, yellow, navy, red, grey and cream piled on the floor.
motion: On load the stickers drop under gravity at a fixed 120 Hz step, bouncing, spinning and colliding until they settle; dragging and releasing throws a sticker with its pointer velocity.
adapt: Physics lives in `solve` (gravity 590, wall and floor restitution 0.62 and 0.47, collision factor 1.45), stepped at 1/120 s by `tick`; `draw` paints the canvas. Replace the `marks` colour and label triples; keep the `settledFrames` idle stop and pointer capture.
